subject: mahoney_patrick_1835

shot.build: stage, tree c30a40136 + 4 uncommitted figure file(s)

silhouette.what: Silhouette and fit of the clothes
silhouette.note: Shirt sleeves, an open waistcoat, braces, a red neckerchief, full brown trousers and a pale slouch hat: Mount's raffle man and his cider makers, who read at 10 m as ours does (a white shirt, a dark waistcoat, brown legs, a hat).

folds.note: The full sleeves now blouse out over a wristband at each wrist and are drawn into it in gathers, as the Raffle's are; soft folds run on up the forearm, faint at 3 m. The shirt is white linen, as every picture's is.

hat_hair.note: A pale broad-brimmed soft felt, as the Raffle man's; Weir's sawyer wears a battered black hat.

skin.note: Coloured pictures; a reconstructed face and complexion, no likeness asserted.

stance.what: How the figure stands or sits
stance.note: Upright; the pictures' men are at work (sawing, at the press), which no standing clip shows.

motion.note: A plain walk; the trousers break and swing.

differences.picture: White shirts (Raffle, Cider Making), white over red (Weir).
differences.ours: White linen, a warm white (sRGB 233, 228, 213 on the stage), not a blue-white; at 3 m and 10 m it reads with the pictures' shirts.

differences.picture: Full sleeves gathered at the wrist into a band (Raffle).
differences.ours: Full sleeves bloused over a 3.4 cm wristband and gathered into it (nine gathers round the arm), soft folds fading up the forearm; the band reads at 3 m, the folds only up close.

differences.picture: Buff (Raffle), brown (Weir) or dark green (Cider Making), worn open, lining-backed.
differences.ours: Dark green, open; the back is green cloth like the front.

differences.picture: Shirt collar under a loose knotted neckerchief (Raffle).
differences.ours: Red neckerchief at the throat, no shirt collar shows.
Brown braces show in the waistcoat's opening.

differences.picture: Full brown or dark trousers (Cider Making, Weir).

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever laid the stills beside the pictures; each checklist item is {what, status, note} with status open | reads | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling — open when a visitor would see the figure is not the pictures’ kind of person in that respect. The first figure of each role is the owner’s call (the plan’s "Your call"); later figures of the role are held to the one he approved.
